categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the television drama and micro-short drama production, investment, distribution, and derivative businesses, as well as film investment, production, distribution, and related derivative businesses. It also provides event execution services and new media services, along with post-production services for film and television works.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as Artificial Intelligence Generated Content (AIGC), virtual shooting, AI face replacement, and integrates AI with intellectual property (IP) for content creation and post-production. It has established an AIGC laboratory and collaborates on AI-driven platforms to enhance scriptwriting, content generation, and video production efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include television stations, new media platforms, intermediaries, and cinema chains. Major partners are central and provincial TV stations in China, leading online video platforms like Youku, Tencent Video, iQIYI, and overseas distributors. The company serves the domestic Chinese market predominantly, with some international distribution.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with headquarters and offices in Zhejiang and Beijing. It also has subsidiaries and operations in Hong Kong and other regions, engaging in overseas distribution and cooperation. Domestic revenue accounts for over 99% of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the film and television supply chain, focusing on content creation, production, and distribution. It acts as both an executive and non-executive producer, managing project development, production, and licensing of content rights.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include producing high-quality, flagship television dramas and micro-short dramas, integrating innovative technologies like AIGC to transform content creation, and building a 'technology + content + ecosystem' business framework. The company aims to develop an intelligent content factory and an open ecological platform to support sustainable growth and expand into interactive and overseas markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through sales of television drama and film copyrights, box office revenue sharing, distribution income, and derivative product sales. Additional income comes from event execution service fees, new media services, and post-production services. The company recognizes revenue upon transfer of control and licensing of content rights.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading content producer within the Zhejiang Broadcasting Group ecosystem, leveraging strong ties with major TV stations and online platforms. It faces competition from other domestic film and television production companies but benefits from its integration with Zhejiang Broadcasting Group and its focus on politically and culturally significant content.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 191 million, a 43.88% decline from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 27.8 million. The company’s asset base is around RMB 1.96 billion with a high asset-liability ratio of 97.23%. Despite recent losses, cash flow from operations improved by 65.54%, supported by a successful private placement that strengthened the balance sheet.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes producing politically aligned, high-quality flagship dramas with strong cultural and historical themes, supported by innovative AI technologies to enhance content creation and production efficiency. Its unique value lies in combining traditional content expertise with cutting-edge technology and leveraging its strategic relationship with Zhejiang Broadcasting Group to secure premium distribution channels.
